editorial:
Imagine sitting back in your living room while some of the biggest stars from Disney's Broadway hits pop in for a giant virtual party. Hosted by Ryan McCartan from his own home, this special concert brings together the magic of theater and the warmth of a family gathering. You get to see famous performers chatting from their own houses, making the whole experience feel personal and cozy. The vibe is all about love, music, and supporting the arts during a tough time, so it feels less like a formal show and more like a big, musical hug for everyone watching.

The highlight has to be the Newsies reunion, where 18 actors get together for a high-energy performance that will make you want to jump out of your seat. The music is polished and the energy stays high throughout the night. While it is a filmed stream and not a polished movie, that just adds to the charm. If you love show tunes, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best sound quality. It is a perfect pick for families or anyone who misses the bright lights of New York City.
endingExplained: The show wraps up with a powerful and emotional performance by the Broadway Inspirational Voices that brings everything together. Instead of a plot twist, the finale focuses on a message of hope and community. The cast gives a final thank you to the viewers for donating to the COVID-19 Emergency Assistance Fund. It ends on a high note, reminding you that the theater community will bounce back and the magic of Disney lives on.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Disney songs and Broadway theater.
